concerns.text: FR-005 states 'apply Bonferroni correction for the primary tests (8 motifs × 2 metrics × 2 correlation types)', but FR-004 enumerates all 3‑node (4) and 4‑node (9) motifs, i.e., 13 motifs. The mismatch makes it unclear which set of motifs the correction should cover, rendering the requirement untestable.

SC-003 expects the log file to contain Bonferroni‑corrected p‑values for all 32 primary tests, yet FR-005’s ambiguous motif count (8 vs 13) means the actual number of tests could be 32 or 52. This inconsistency makes the success criterion unmeasurable.
